about_the_game:
Climb, fall and try again

This is a physics-based, 2.5D platforming game where your goal is to get to the top. But the path is anything but easy.

With precise jumps and an unforgiving environment, this game is built for those who chase the satisfaction of progress earned through skill and persistence. Every fall is a lesson. Every step higher is a small victory.

Whether you're casually playing looking for a challenge as a speed runner, the experience is built to be fair, fast and focused, with increased difficulty as you play.

New Game+ and Special Modes:

Once you've conquered the climb, it doesn’t end there. Unlock a tougher version of the core game with special gameplay modifiers (that change how you move, jump, or see the world) and time trials.

🛠 LEVEL EDITOR - Coming Soon:

A diverse in-game level editor is in development, allowing you to design, test, and share your own stages. Challenge your friends, test your own abilities and see what you can create!

🎮 Key Features:

  • Physics-based, 2.5D precision platforming - vertically,

  • Smooth performance - on all sorts of hardware,

  • Stylized visuals - with occlusion culling and optimized assets,

  • Minimalist, responsive controls,

  • No checkpoints - one mistake and you're done,

  • Level editor (coming soon!) - for community-made content and endless fun,

  • Speed-runner Friendly - In-game timers and achievements

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 8 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or equivalent (2GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: ~2–4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or better (4GB VRAM)

  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
